$comment: GATING FOR ABLATION CLAIMS. Answers A-11a, A-11b, A-11c. AUTHORIZES NOTHING -- no lane, no allocation, no artifact change, no spend. Does not alter the certified run, which continues unchanged.
provenance_caveat: The researcher extension reaches me only as one lane's report. There is no researcher slot in this mailbox. This ruling is CONDITIONAL in the same sense as persona_pair_construction_and_probe_placement.json, and ratifies no researcher decision.

THE_REFERRED_ASYMMETRY_IS_CORRECT_AND_I_.their_finding: An incomplete group under AMPLIFICATION yields a WEAKER effect -- a visible false negative nobody writes up as a discovery. An incomplete group under ABLATION yields NO effect, and the honest-looking conclusion is 'these features are not necessary'. That is a false negative that READS AS A POSITIVE FINDING.
THE_REFERRED_ASYMMETRY_IS_CORRECT_AND_I_.accepted: Correct, and it is the worst class in this sprint's catalogue for exactly the reason they cite: a confident wrong answer ends investigation while a missing one prompts it.

THE_STRONGER_FORM_THEIR_FRAMING_DOES_NOT.statement: SUFFICIENCY SURVIVES THE RECALL CAVEAT. NECESSITY DOES NOT. The difference is not how the error reads -- it is what the pool can support IN PRINCIPLE.
THE_STRONGER_FORM_THEIR_FRAMING_DOES_NOT.sufficiency: A set that produces the concept produces it REGARDLESS of what else exists. Demonstrating sufficiency never required having found every feature, so a low-recall pool does not undermine it. A sufficient set found in a biased pool is still a sufficient set.
THE_STRONGER_FORM_THEIR_FRAMING_DOES_NOT.necessity: A set is necessary only if NO OTHER ROUTE carries the concept. Establishing that requires knowing what else exists -- which is precisely what a low-recall pool cannot tell you.
THE_STRONGER_FORM_THEIR_FRAMING_DOES_NOT.consequence: Group necessity is not merely harder to report honestly from this pool. IT IS NOT ESTABLISHABLE FROM IT AT ALL, in principle rather than in practice.

BUT_ONE_ABLATION_OUTCOME_IS_STILL_LICENS.positive_ablation: If ablating the set REMOVES the concept, that IS informative and is NOT undermined by recall: whatever else exists was not sufficient to carry it. This is a real and publishable result.
BUT_ONE_ABLATION_OUTCOME_IS_STILL_LICENS.null_ablation: If the concept survives, nothing follows. An unnecessary set and an incomplete set are indistinguishable.
BUT_ONE_ABLATION_OUTCOME_IS_STILL_LICENS.the_symmetry_with_the_probe: This is the same positive/null asymmetry already frozen for the jointly-only probe. A positive is decisive; a null has no power. The doctrine is now consistent across both instruments.

RULING_A11a_group_necessity_is_a_SEPARAT.question: Is group-necessity a third conjunct alongside sufficiency and minimality, a separate claim with its own threshold, or out of scope?
RULING_A11a_group_necessity_is_a_SEPARAT.verdict: A SEPARATE CLAIM, WITH ITS OWN EVIDENCE AND ITS OWN CAVEAT. It is NOT a third conjunct and it may NEVER be a precondition for publishing a sufficient minimal set.
RULING_A11a_group_necessity_is_a_SEPARAT.their_premise_is_right: Minimality is defined in the SUFFICIENCY direction -- it asks whether every member is needed for the SET TO STEER. Group necessity asks whether the CONCEPT SURVIVES without the set. Neither implies the other, and a set can be minimally sufficient while being far from necessary if the model carries the concept by several independent routes.
why_NOT_a_conjunct: A minimally sufficient set is a real, useful and publishable finding on its own -- it is exactly what a steering tool needs in order to know what to amplify. Requiring necessity would discard valid steering sets for failing a different test.
Bundling them lets a necessity NULL block a sufficiency claim the evidence fully supports. That is the wrong coupling and it inverts the direction of the error.

DECISIVE: under the permanent recall caveat, group necessity is not reliably measurable at all. A conjunct that cannot be reliably measured becomes either a gate that always fails or a gate that gets waved through, and both are worse than an honestly bounded separate claim.

what_MAY_be_claimed.publishable_primary: Joint sufficiency plus minimality, exactly as frozen in steering_feature_set_definition RULING_3. Unchanged.
what_MAY_be_claimed.publishable_secondary_only_on_a_POSITIVE: Ablating this set removed the concept. Reportable, with the set named and the paired same-seed control stated.
what_MAY_be_claimed.never_publishable: Any necessity claim resting on a null ablation.

RULING_A11b_the_null_ablation_phrasing_i.why_now: For the same reason the probe's null clause was frozen before the probe existed: written afterwards, the identical sentence cannot be distinguished from a rationalisation. The referral is right that this is a null which will be TEMPTING to report as a finding, which makes early freezing more important rather than less.
RULING_A11b_the_null_ablation_phrasing_i.FROZEN_PHRASING: Ablating this set did not remove the concept. We cannot distinguish an unnecessary set from an incomplete one.
RULING_A11b_the_null_ablation_phrasing_i.adopted_verbatim_from_the_referral: The coordinator proposed this wording. It is accepted as written; I have not improved on it.
PROHIBITED_READINGS: these features are not necessary for the concept
the concept does not depend on this set
any sentence in which a null ablation appears without the incomplete-set alternative stated in the same sentence
RULING_A11b_the_null_ablation_phrasing_i.why_each_is_prohibited: Every one of them asserts absence from an instrument that cannot detect presence. Each is a false negative wearing the grammar of a positive finding.

RULING_A11c_the_cost_model_changes_and_h.prior_figure: (k+1) generation conditions per set per prompt: one joint intervention plus k leave-one-out.
RULING_A11c_the_cost_model_changes_and_h.REVISED: (k+2). The group-ablation arm adds ONE condition per set per prompt.
RULING_A11c_the_cost_model_changes_and_h.why_only_one: The paired same-seed control is the unmodified generation already required by the joint arm. It is REUSED, not duplicated. The frozen control-arm rule already mandates one control per (concept, pairing, direction, locale, prompt_id, seed) at the SAME SEED, so no additional control is generated.

THE_PLUS_K_VARIANT_IS_REFUSED_NOT_PRICED.what_it_would_buy: Leave-one-out under ablation, to attribute necessity to individual members.
THE_PLUS_K_VARIANT_IS_REFUSED_NOT_PRICED.why_it_is_refused: Necessity of an individual member within a group is even less establishable from a low-recall pool than necessity of the group. It would double the lane's cost to purchase a claim RULING_A11a already prohibits.
THE_PLUS_K_VARIANT_IS_REFUSED_NOT_PRICED.so_do_not_size_for_it: The referral asked not to be surprised by a doubled requirement. The answer is that the doubling buys nothing admissible: budget (k+2), not (2k+2).

RULING_A11c_the_cost_model_changes_and_h.worked_example: At k=3: 4 conditions per set per prompt becomes 5. A 25 percent increase, not 100 percent.

THE_RUNNING_JOB_413287_HANDLING_IS_RATIF.coordinator_position: The run returns one feature per concept plus a full-ablation result for that ONE feature, for all fourteen concepts. Under the group requirement those per-feature ablation results are CANDIDATE EVIDENCE, not necessity claims, and will be recorded that way.
THE_RUNNING_JOB_413287_HANDLING_IS_RATIF.verdict: CORRECT AND RATIFIED. That is precisely the right handling.
THE_RUNNING_JOB_413287_HANDLING_IS_RATIF.and_it_follows_from_the_ruling_above: A single-feature ablation is the k=1 case of a group ablation, so it inherits the same asymmetry: a POSITIVE single-feature ablation is informative and reportable; a NULL is subject to the frozen phrasing above and asserts nothing.
THE_RUNNING_JOB_413287_HANDLING_IS_RATIF.the_run_is_not_devalued: It produces the candidate pool and validates the pipeline on real weights. What it may not do is support a sentence of the form 'this concept depends on this feature'.

hard_stops: Making group necessity a precondition for publishing a sufficient minimal set.
Reporting any necessity claim from a null ablation, in any wording.
Reporting a null ablation without the incomplete-set alternative in the same sentence.
Sizing a joint-intervention lane at (2k+2) for member-attributed necessity, which is refused.
Reading a single-feature ablation from job 413287 as a necessity claim.
Treating this ruling as authorization for a lane, an allocation, an artifact change, or any spend.
